messages:
maria: Heads up — the monitoring alert is flagging a bunch of requests to /v1/embeddings that used tokens which should only have 'embeddings:read', but the gateway accepted them for chat:create as well.
ken: on it. can you paste an example log line? we need request id + token id
maria: log snippet:
```
INFO 2026-03-19T18:20:34Z req=abc123 route=/v1/embeddings token_id=tok_9xj audit_scope_claim=missing allowed_actions=[chat.create, embeddings.read]
```
maria: note audit_scope_claim is missing — that's new after last week's rbac-service migration.
sasha: missing claim in the audit event means enforcement probably fell back to legacy behavior. did we change how token metadata is stored in KMS? ken: yes — RBAC v2 migrated scope attributes into KMS secret metadata via the ksm-sync job. that job had a small schema change last deploy.
dave: if ksm-sync dropped the scope field on some secrets, the enforcement layer currently treats absent scope as 'legacy-allow' which is how this slipped through. we need an emergency safeguard.
ken: quick mitigation: add a hard deny in the edge proxy for any token missing a scope claim for action=chat.create and model=*chat* — I can push that as a patch to the gateway config now.
maria: do it. also start a backfill to read scope from backup store and reattach to KMS metadata. we should rotate tokens that lack scopes.
audit-bot: 1849901250 audit: detected 3,214 requests with missing scope claim between 2026-03-19T18:10Z and 18:25Z. top routes: /v1/embeddings, /internal/rerank
sasha: for the backfill: prefer idempotent script. plan: (1) query old-token-table for scopes, (2) call ksm.set_metadata(token_id, {scopes: [...]}) under a dry-run flag, (3) promote after sample verification.
dave: also add a temporary enforcement rule at the model-router: deny any chat.create calls from tokens issued before migration_ts unless they have explicit scope metadata. that'll reduce blast radius while we fix KMS.
ken: patching gateway now; will route a canary to 10% traffic then 100% if green. I'll also escalate KMS job history to infra on-call.
maria: good. once we have fix + backfill + rotate plan, open an incident and postmortem. include timeline and list of affected customers.
sasha: noted — I'll open the incident doc, add owner tags, and create the postmortem template.
maria: thanks. keep updates here. :lock:
